strings.zh: 哎呀呀！这不是{VAR:0103:0}吗。{SCROLL}来得正好啊！{NEWLINE}{VAR:0101:1}也长大了啊！{SCROLL}今天是一起来口袋竞技场的吧？{SCROLL}既然大家已经聚齐了,{NEWLINE}那就尽情地玩耍吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh my, my! If it isn’t {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}Perfect timing!{NEWLINE}{VAR:0101:1} has grown up too!{SCROLL}You came to the Pokéathlon Dome{NEWLINE}together today, right?{SCROLL}Now that everyone’s here, go have all{NEWLINE}the fun you want!{SCROLL}{SCROLL}
So, what would you like to do?

strings.zh: 是吗,那太遗憾了,{NEWLINE}欢迎再来！
strings.en: Oh, that’s too bad.{NEWLINE}Do come again!
All right. Be sure to come!{SCROLL}{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 首先你自己练练手怎么样？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Why don’t you practice on your{NEWLINE}own first?{SCROLL}{SCROLL}
Hmm? What is it?{NEWLINE}Ask me anything!

strings.zh: 口袋竞技场是⋯⋯{SCROLL}训练师和精灵{NEWLINE}一起玩的一种体育运动！{SCROLL}非常简单！{NEWLINE}比如掷飞碟或者赛跑等⋯⋯{SCROLL}一旦玩起劲,{NEWLINE}大婶都有可能夺取胜利呢！{SCROLL}你也可以和精灵一起玩玩看嘛！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Pokéathlon is...{SCROLL}a sport that Trainers and Pokémon{NEWLINE}play together!{SCROLL}It’s really simple! Like throwing discs,{NEWLINE}or running races...{SCROLL}Once you get into it, even an old lady{NEWLINE}like me could win!{SCROLL}Why not give it a try with your Pokémon?{SCROLL}{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 规则很简单,{NEWLINE}四支由三只精灵{SCROLL}组成的队伍,{NEWLINE}参加三个比试的项目,{SCROLL}所有比试完成之后,{NEWLINE}得分最高者就是{SCROLL}冠{SCROLL}　　军{SCROLL}　　　　　哦！！{SCROLL}呵呵,我一不小心兴奋起来了。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The rules are simple.{NEWLINE}Four teams of three Pokémon each{SCROLL}compete in three events.{SCROLL}When all the events are over,{NEWLINE}the one with the most points is the{SCROLL}CHAM-{SCROLL}PI-{SCROLL}ON!!{SCROLL}Ho ho, I got a little too excited.{SCROLL}{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 队名可以更改,{SCROLL}可以取一个能让人热血沸腾的好名字！{SCROLL}
strings.en: You can change your team name.{SCROLL}Pick a great name that gets everyone’s{NEWLINE}blood pumping!{SCROLL}{SCROLL}
